content.title: Manchester City vs Liverpool - as it happened
content.text: Manchester City vs Liverpool, 2025/26 FA Cup, quarter-finals, 04/04/2026, starting lineups. BeSoccer Join us for LIVE coverage of the FA Cup quarter-finals fixture between Manchester City and Liverpool, kick-off at 13.45 CET, at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England. List of goalscorers Match report in news FT (4-0): Manchester City produced a dominant display to defeat Liverpool 4-0 on Saturday at Etihad Stadium, having led 2-0 at the break before taking full control after half-time. Thank you for joining us and see you soon! Nicolas Gonzalez is booked. Yellow card a Manchester City Konate is cautioned by the referee. The Cityzens must now bide their time, with their next opponent only to be decided once the final quarter-final is played on Sunday. Despite Liverpool enjoying sustained possession high up the pitch, City appear far more dangerous, with the space opening up for quick counters continuing to favour the hosts. Liverpool sub: Salah is replaced by Chiesa. Manchester City sub: Haaland goes off and Marmoush comes on. Manchester City double sub: Cherki and Semenyo OUT. Foden and Reijnders IN. Liverpool sub: Ekitike is replaced by Gakpo. Substitution at Liverpool Substitution at Liverpool Liverpool sub: Wirtz is replaced by Rio Ngumoha. Silva goes into the book after pulling back Gravenberch to stop the move. Kerkez sees yellow after catching Savinho with a late challenge, prompting the referee to intervene. It rather sums up Liverpool's afternoon as Salah aims low towards the corner, but Trafford reads it well, gets across sharply and keeps it out with a firm save. Liverpool sub: Joe Gomez is replaced by Frimpong. Manchester City double sub: Doku and Rodri OUT. Savinho and Nico Gonzalez IN. Goaaaaaal! de Manchester City en el 57' Statistics of E. Haaland in FA Cup 1.5 GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLLLL FOR MAN CITY! A flowing move down the left sees Doku and O'Reilly combine before the latter squares it across goal for Haaland, who finishes from close range via the bar to complete his hat-trick and tighten City's grip on the game! Gravenberch picks out a clever line of pass from distance, threading it neatly into Salah inside the area. The Egyptian hits it first time without hesitation, but the effort flies high and never threatens the target. Just as Salah looks ready to spark a response, Trafford steps up with a superb intervention, springing to his right and getting a strong hand to the effort to keep City firmly in control. Goaaaaaal! de Manchester City en el 50' Statistics of A. Semenyo in FA Cup 0.5 GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLLL FOR MAN CITY! Liverpool appeal in vain for offside, but Semenyo times his run to perfection, darting in behind Van Dijk before lifting a composed left-footed finish over Mamardashvili. Frustration bubbles over on the touchline as Slot and his bench protest angrily after Manchester City are awarded a free-kick, following a challenge by Gomez. The match resumes after the interval with both sides sticking to the same line-ups, neither manager opting to make an immediate switch. HT (2-0): Manchester City went into the interval in control, with Haaland striking twice to punish Liverpool despite their promising spells. The Reds had created the clearer openings early on but failed to take them, allowing City to grow into the contest and seize command. We'll see what happens next! Goaaaaaal! de Manchester City en el 47' Statistics of E. Haaland in FA Cup 1.5 GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLLL FOR MAN CITY! Semenyo slips in unnoticed on an overlapping run down the right, reaches the byline and whips a precise cross into the danger area. Waiting in the middle, Haaland rises with authority and powers a header into the far corner to extend City's advantage! The fourth official signals for two minutes of added time as the first half edges towards its conclusion, offering a brief window for either side to make a late impact before the interval. Liverpool may feel hard done by to be trailing given their share of the play, but their inability to take two clear openings has proved costly, leaving them with plenty to rue as they fall behind. Goaaaaal from a penalty! de Manchester City en el 39' Statistics of E. Haaland in FA Cup 1.5 GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLLL FOR MAN CITY! The Etihad Stadium roars as Haaland keeps his composure from twelve yards. He slows his run with a subtle pause, sends the goalkeeper the wrong way and then drives a powerful finish low into the bottom corner to put City in front! O'Reilly spins inside the box looking to get his shot away, but Van Dijk clips him and sends him to ground. With a clear view of the incident, Michael Oliver wastes no time in pointing to the spot. Cherki takes charge of the corner and curls a teasing inswinger towards the six-yard area. Rising above the crowd, Van Dijk meets it with authority, powering a header clear to relieve the pressure. Yellow card a Manchester City Rodri halts the move by tugging at the shirt of Ekitike and the referee has no hesitation in reaching for his pocket to issue a booking. Liverpool tease their way forward with a string of clever flicks and intricate touches around the edge of City's box, but the move becomes one pass too many, and the opportunity fades as possession is surrendered. Cherki engineers the opening and feeds Doku on the right, who whips a dangerous ball across goal. Alert to the threat, the Liverpool goalkeeper reacts sharply, diving low to his right to gather and keep it out! Liverpool carve out another promising opening, working the ball neatly down the right before Salah delivers a dangerous cross into the area. It drops invitingly for Ekitike, but with the ball bouncing awkwardly, he sends his effort over the bar! R. Gravenberch Midfielder Gravenberch becomes the first name in the referee's notebook after dragging down Doku. Bernardo Silva steps up once more over the dead ball and whips a dangerous delivery into the area. It is met in commanding fashion by Ekitike, who climbs above the crowd to head it clear. City surround the referee in appeal as Kerkez collides with the advancing Cherki right on the edge of the area. There is a moment of expectation from the visitors, but the decision does not go their way, with play allowed to continue. Liverpool turn defence into attack in a flash, Mamardashvili'S long restart springing Salah clear on the counter. He drives into the box with menace, but when the moment arrives, his left-footed effort slides narrowly wide of the far post! The tide begins to turn, with the Sky Blues now stepping higher up the pitch and working the ball patiently around the edge of the area, searching for a way through. A slick passage unfolds down the left as Wirtz and Ekitike combine with real intent, carving open a pocket of space. The move ends with Ekitike stepping onto it just outside the box, but his effort drifts wide of the mark. Liverpool piece together a flowing attacking move, with Wirtz and Szoboszlai combining sharply to prise open space in the final third. The first phase breaks down, but they quickly win it back, and when it falls once more to Szoboszlai, he hits it firmly, only for his effort to be blocked. A clever exchange unfolds on the edge of the area as Wirtz clips a delicate ball towards Ekitike on the left side of the box. The Frenchman returns the favour with a tidy lay-off, setting Wirtz up for a close-range attempt, but just as the moment opens up, Khusanov throws himself in the way to make a crucial block. Manchester City waste no time asserting themselves, moving the ball with purpose from the outset. O'Reilly threads a neat pass into the path of Doku, who takes it in stride through the middle before unleashing a speculative effort from range. Manchester City get us going in light blue from left to right, while Liverpool are in red! Start of match Liverpool starting XI: Mamardashvili (GK); Gomez, Van Dijk, Konate, Kerkez; Gravenberch, Szoboszlai, Jones; Ekitike, Wirtz and Salah. Manchester City starting XI: Trafford (GK); Nunes, Khusanov, Guehi, O'Reilly; Rodri, Bernardo Silva, Semenyo; Cherki, Doku and Haaland. Michael Oliver will take charge on the pitch for this one, with Paul Howard serving as the VAR. Liverpool possible lineup: Mamardashvili (GK); Szoboszlai, Konate, Van Dijk, Kerkez; Mac Allister, Gravenberch; Salah, Wirtz, Gakpo; Ekitike. Manchester City possible lineup: Trafford (GK); Nunes, Khusanov, Guehi, Ait-Nouri; Bernardo, Rodri, O’Reilly; Semenyo, Haaland and Cherki. The tie at the Etihad may ultimately be decided by which version of Liverpool appears: the side that has struggled for goals in the league, or one capable of rediscovering its attacking edge against a City team whose firepower has remained largely intact. Despite leading Liverpool to a record-equalling 20th English top-flight title less than a year ago, Slot is under huge pressure to end a difficult second season on a high if he is to remain in the job. After visiting the Etihad, Slot's men face European champions Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League quarter-finals over two legs on April 8 and 14. Liverpool face a defining 10 days for their season and possibly Arne Slot's future at Anfield. Languishing fifth in the Premier League, the FA Cup and Champions League are the Reds' only remaining hope of glory. They remain in the running to match their feat as the only English side to ever win the domestic treble of League Cup, FA Cup and Premier League in 2018/19. City produced perhaps their best performance of the season to dominate Arsenal and win the League Cup final 2-0 before the international break. Pre-match 04 April 2026, 13:45 Referee: Michael Oliver | VAR: Paul Howard Stadium: Etihad Stadium Hello everyone, and welcome to live coverage of the FA Cup quarter-finals fixture between Manchester City and Liverpool, kick-off at 13.45 CET, at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England!
